notes: The photo-read deadline is now evidence-based. A first-ever vLLM boot downloads the whole model (~16GB for Qwen2.5-VL-7B) and legitimately takes longer than the 3-minute budget — the previous build gave up mid-download. Now, when the deadline hits, the app asks the endpoint's health API what's actually happening: a worker initializing or grinding through a queue backlog earns more time (in 2-minute extensions, up to a 10-minute hard cap, with the caption 'your GPU is still booting — hanging on'), while an endpoint with no workers at all fails immediately with the real numbers and the fix. Combined with the background service, a first boot can now complete unattended.
